hints.content: $\green{\text{Step }1}$ added $3$ to the left side of the equation and subtracted $3$ from the right side of the equation.

This is a mistake!

$3$ should have been added to both sides of the equation.

question.content:
Mia tried to solve an equation step by step.

$\qquad\begin{align}
0.1t-3&=5\\\\
\\
0.1t&=2&\green{\text{Step } 1}\\\\
\\
t&=20&\blue{\text{Step } 2}\\\\
\end{align}$

**Find Mia's mistake.**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: Mia did not make a mistake.
